title: Updates Checkout Session UI mode enum values
changed: hosted, embedded and custom removed from checkout.sessions.create ui_mode
elements, embedded_page and hosted_page added to Checkout.Session.ui_mode
Checkout.Session.ui_mode no longer returns hosted, embedded or custom
reason: Only with fullDiff (oasdiff; the watch worker default, off in `refit run` and in the benchmark fix stage): compareOpenApi (openapi-diff.ts) reports the request change and findBreakingOperationImpacts (provider-operations.ts) lists every traced call of that operation as an operation impact, which blocks AI and stops the run in scanReviewReason (workflow.ts), whether or not the call sends the changed value. Without fullDiff Refit reports nothing.

changed: elements, embedded_page and hosted_page added to Checkout.Session.ui_mode
parts.how: Only with fullDiff: compareOpenApi lists Stripe response enum additions as compatible (openResponseEnums), and switchedEnumAdditions (openapi-diff.ts) adds a blocking entry for the new value where traced code switches over the field, assigns it to `never`, or compares it with string literals (`===`, `!==`, `==`, `!=` or `['a'].includes(...)`; analyzer.ts enumChecks, owner decision 6). unmappedBreakingChanges keeps that entry, so scanReviewReason (workflow.ts) stops the run for review and publication is blocked. Other reads need no edit. Without fullDiff nothing is reported.

changed: Checkout.Session.ui_mode no longer returns hosted, embedded or custom
parts.how: Only with fullDiff, and only because the same release adds `elements`, `embedded_page` and `hosted_page` to the field: a compare with the old value (`x.field === <old value>`, `!==`, `==`, `!=` or `['a'].includes(...)`) is an enumCheck since owner decision 6 (analyzer.ts), so switchedEnumAdditions (openapi-diff.ts) reports the added values there and scanReviewReason (workflow.ts) stops the run for review. The entry names the added values, not the replaced one; reads that do not compare or switch are not reported. Without fullDiff nothing is reported.
